evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never delivered the time-boxed framing ('10 to 15 minutes') or asked 'does that sound good?' before jumping into probing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep never asked 'what are your biggest concerns about this move?' — instead responded reactively to customer's unprompted statement about getting multiple quotes.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Moving day not asked. Distance (61 miles) and items confirmed, but no explicit moving date captured.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type, floor/stories, number of rooms, walking distance, and special considerations all absent. Only item list gathered (washer/dryer, dining set, dresser, desk, boxes, TV) and distance/drive time.
evidence_quotes.box_count: Not asked — customer volunteered '10 to 12 boxes,' but rep did not probe or offer box count framing.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Range given ($762–$915, adjusted to $660–$700 if 2.5–3.5 hours) but not anchored to home size or typical move profile — no 'for a home your size' framing.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Trip fee ($150) disclosed; 2.5-hour minimum and pay-for-time mentioned. No 15-minute-increments language. Deposit/cancellation policy mentioned late, near call end ('don't pay until after the move...free to reserve...free to cancel').
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_silence: Never asked 'does that feel fair?' — no pause or check-in after pricing.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep did not ask 'does that put those to rest?' or confirm understanding of the two promises (neither of which were delivered anyway).
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Call ended with customer saying 'I may call you back today' and rep saying 'I'm sending this over right now' — no 'what's still concerning you?' or genuine final check.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked 'would you like our help with your move?' — customer drove the conversation toward closure ('I'm getting a quote today...we'll make a decision', 'I may call you back today') and rep responded with email/ticket confirmation only.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Yes — deposit and cancellation policy disclosed: 'you don't pay for anything with us until after the move...it's free to reserve the truck and it's free to cancel the truck.'

top_strength: Rep accurately adjusted the estimate downward based on the customer's actual item list and distance, demonstrating real-time pricing flexibility and transparency about what the adjustment meant ('big difference').
coaching_note: Open with the quid pro quo framing and wait for a yes before probing; ask 'what are your biggest concerns?' early and in Section 2, not reactively; deliver both Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Coverage) in Section 5; and end every call with an explicit ask ('would you like our help with your move?') in Section 7, not just sending a quote and waiting.
